subject: Azure Marketplace: Offer technical onboarding & tenant checks
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@microsoft.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Azure Marketplace: initial technical onboarding request

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for making time yesterday. Per our call, we want to move our Offer into the publisher portal next week and need to complete the technical validation checklist so Contoso can opt into co-sell. Attached is our drafted package and the checklist we filled out. Can you confirm the exact tenant and AD app permissions you need from our side for the validation run?

Quick context: this is a SaaS offer (hosted API) with a small VM-based management plane for billing/usage reporting. We will host the offer in East US and need co-sell registration afterwards.

Planned timeline: publish package by 11/24 if validation is green.

Attachments: azure-publisher-technical-checklist.xlsx, offer-package-draft.pdf

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@microsoft.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@contoso.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial technical onboarding request

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the package. A few items from the validation side:

- Tenant: please provide your Publisher Tenant ID (GUID). We need Contributor rights scoped to the publisher resource group for the validation run, not subscription-wide.
- AD App: create a service principal with Application.Read.All and Directory.Read.All for the test run; we will only use it to programmatically verify offer endpoints and SSO metadata.
- URLs: the offer listing page and manifest must be reachable via HTTPS with a valid cert (no self-signed).
- Telemetry: provide a short-lived test key for the API so we can exercise usage reporting end-to-end.

I opened a validation ticket (MP-7219). Please attach the tenant screenshot and the filled checklist to that ticket. I've added Marketplace Ops to keep the Contoso product team in the loop.

We can do the hands-on validation call on 11/19 at 14:00 PT — does that work?

Cheers,
Anita
Azure Marketplace Technical Onboarding
Microsoft Corporation
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@microsoft.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T12:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial technical onboarding request

Anita —

Thanks, we'll get that over. Quick answers inline:

- Tenant ID: attaching publisher-tenant-screenshot.png.
- AD app: we'll provision the service principal and share credentials in the secure ticket (temporary secrets).
- URLs: staging endpoints are behind a valid cert; we'll provide the final listing URL once the manifest is packaged.
- Telemetry/test key: generating a short-lived test key and will share only inside the MP ticket.

11/19 14:00 PT works for the team. Looping in Karthik to own validation run and to capture action items for the rollout checklist.

Action items (owner):
- Karthik: create SP, attach creds to ticket (by 11/18)
- Marissa: finalize offer package PDF and SKU list (by 11/18)
- Lauren: confirm co-sell paperwork readiness with Contoso (by 11/19)

Thanks —
Rishi
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@microsoft.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial technical onboarding request

Hi Anita —

I attached the service principal details in MP-7219 and uploaded the filled checklist (see attachment azure-publisher-technical-checklist.xlsx). The SP has Application.Read.All and Directory.Read.All; secret expires 2026-12-01.

Notes from my test run against staging (short):
- Manifest validation: one warning on telemetry schema (we fixed); no blockers.
- OAuth redirect URI: the management plane had an extra trailing slash that broke validation; corrected.
- Billing webhook: responded with 200 on our test script.

I'll be on the 11/19 session to walk through the validation steps and to share logs.

Regards,
Karthik
Integration Engineer

Date: 2026-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial technical onboarding request

Team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Summary from validation run today:

- Result: PASS (no critical blockers).
- Outstanding items before publishing: update manifest description to include co-sell terms, and upload signed co-sell agreement to the publisher portal (Marketplace Ops will confirm).
- Next steps: Contoso will perform final commercial review; once they sign the co-sell addendum we can flip the offer to live and enable co-sell registration.

Links:
- Validation ticket: https://microsoft.atlassian.net/browse/MP-7219
- Publish portal: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Marketplace/PublisherOverview

Anita will follow up with a DocuSign for the co-sell addendum and Marketplace Ops will confirm when to move to production.

Thanks everyone — great collaboration.

Best,
Anita
